Markets.title: iPhone Duo internal display break: Are iPhone Duo displays too fragile? Users report alarming cracks near hinge
Markets.summary: Users are reporting that the inner displays of the new iPhone Duo are cracking near the hinge after minimal use. Apple is currently investigating these reports to determine if there is a manufacturing defect.

Markets.title: US Markets Today: Dow ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed meet
Markets.summary: US stocks fell at the end of a turbulent week, with the Dow dropping 1.25% amid growing doubts about artificial intelligence investments. Investors now await upcoming earnings reports from major tech companies and next week's Federal Reserve meeting.

Markets.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
Markets.summary: Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles reported a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue from operations surged 42% to ₹23,930 crore, driven by improved demand from higher fleet utilization and industrial activity.

Markets.title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
Markets.summary: BofA Global Research estimates that global data centre spending will reach $1 trillion in 2026 and surge to $2.1 trillion by 2028. This rapid infrastructure expansion is driven by the increasing demand for artificial intelligence services.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose following a previous drop, though the 10-year yield remained below 5% amid ongoing artificial intelligence market concerns. Bond markets were also influenced by strong economic activity and sticky inflation, while expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weakened.

Markets.title: EAAA India Alternatives mops up Rs 360 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on Oct 26
Markets.summary: EAAA India Alternatives raised about Rs 360 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering. The IPO, which consists entirely of an offer for sale, opens for public subscription on October 26.

Geo-Political.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has described a deadly shooting near Paris that left one person dead and five wounded as a racist terrorist attack. A suspected gunman has been apprehended in connection with the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen opened fire at a church funeral in Jordan's Karak governorate, killing seven people and injuring thirty-four others. Authorities have launched a manhunt to apprehend the attackers.

Geo-Political.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
Geo-Political.summary: Former Ukrainian prisoners report that a recently freed US citizen was subjected to torture, including beatings and sexual humiliation, by Russian guards while detained in a Russian jail. The witnesses stated they personally observed this abuse during their time held alongside the American.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
Geo-Political.summary: Following the fatal shooting of two Israeli soldiers by Palestinian gunmen at a West Bank checkpoint on Friday, Israeli forces began demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron. The attack and subsequent demolitions mark an escalation of violence in the region.

Geo-Political.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
Geo-Political.summary: The White House announced that Melania Trump successfully brokered a truce in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky. Residents of the city had been facing severe conditions, including being forced to eat garden weeds to survive.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
Geo-Political.summary: Argentine prosecutors dropped an investigation into President Javier Milei regarding his involvement in promoting a cryptocurrency that later crashed. Milei had previously denied any fraudulent behavior after deleting a social media post about the digital asset.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry options. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in an evolving landscape.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is boosting its domestic manufacturing of tunnel boring machines as construction progresses on the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line. This rail project will feature 16 tunnels to advance connectivity across the Himalayas.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to increased manufacturing, services, and new orders alongside easing inflation. However, job growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Simply taxing the top one percent of earners is insufficient for resolving income inequality. How governments choose to spend public revenue is equally crucial for achieving true social justice.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. This recovery occurred because refiners purchased spot cargoes as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers shared differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

India.title: CBI Arrests Two ED Officials In Rs 5 Lakh Bribery Case
India.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) arrested two Enforcement Directorate (ED) officials in a bribery case. The accused were caught taking Rs 5 lakh to provide favorable treatment to a complainant's father in an ongoing case.

India.title: Gangster Himanshu Bhau, Wanted In India For Multiple Murders, Arrested In US
India.summary: Himanshu Bhau, an Indian gangster wanted for multiple murders, kidnappings, and extortions, has been arrested in the United States. He was previously on the most-wanted lists of both the Haryana and Delhi Police and is a rival of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi.

India.title: 5 Killed In Explosion At House Storing Firecrackers In Bihar
India.summary: An explosion at a house storing firecrackers in Bihar killed five people. A forensic science laboratory team is currently investigating the scene.

India.title: 14 Indians Safe After Boat Got Involved In Incident Off Yemen Coast: Embassy
India.summary: The Indian embassy reported that 14 Indian citizens are safe following a boat incident off the coast of Yemen. Ministry of New Delhi spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal made the announcement during a media briefing.

India.title: College Student Accuses TVK Worker Of Sexual Assault, Then A U-turn
India.summary: A college student accused a TVK worker of sexual assault before reversing her statement. DMK MP Kanimozhi Karunanidhi subsequently asked Chief Minister Vijay what action he would take against the party functionary.

India.title: IndiGo Extends Saudi Flight Cancellations Till October 27 Amid Houthi Attacks
India.summary: IndiGo has extended the cancellation of its flights to Saudi Arabia until October 27. This decision comes in response to escalating drone and missile attacks by Yemen's Houthi rebels targeting Saudi infrastructure.

General.title: Storm Austen brings power cuts and travel disruption as more wind and rain forecast
General.summary: Storm Austen has caused power cuts and travel disruption with high winds and heavy rain. A second weather system, Storm Boelo, is forecast to bring more severe weather to Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England on Saturday.

General.title: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
General.summary: Meghan Markle issued a statement confirming she was informed in 2018 about disturbing allegations against her father. Her father, Thomas Markle, is reportedly being investigated over child sex abuse images in the Philippines.

General.summary: Meghan released a statement regarding her relationship with her father, addressing questions that have persisted for years. Without using the specific word, her statement essentially claimed vindication.

General.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
General.summary: The UK chancellor will announce a £100 million investment to establish an AI Biosecurity Lab during Wednesday's Budget. This funding aims to strengthen the country's national security defences against potential artificial intelligence threats.

General.title: Father who killed Oregon school shooter describes anguish over children he couldn't save
General.summary: Kaylub Giamanco is hailed as a hero for killing an armed teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher at an Oregon school. Giamanco has since expressed deep anguish over the children he was unable to save.
